timing: Post-run read-only independent derivation; not a pre-registration, before-result receipt, new observation, or re-fit
shared_preprocessing: voxel grid occupancy and center coordinates
PCA frame from all occupied centers
5%-95% axial boundaries from all occupied centers
raw-point inverse occupied-cell population weights from all deduplicated points

procedures.raw_fold_membership: unique(input_points); occupied_cell=floor(point/voxel); values=(point-frozen_origin)@frozen_frame/voxel; searchsorted(frozen_axial_boundaries/voxel, values_z, side=right)-1; uppermost equality is slice 5
procedures.shared_cells: intersection of occupied-cell IDs among slices 0/2/4 and 1/3/5, then swap; no models re-fit
procedures.heldout_points_in_shared_cells: count heldout raw points whose occupied-cell ID also occurs in train

report_change.scope: Only heldout/preprocessing clarification and next-step paragraph
